next.reason: 1985: "The storage area associated with identifier-1 and the record area associated with file-name-1 must not be the same storage area."; 2023: "14.6.10, Overlapping operands, and 14.9.25, MOVE statement, General rules, apply to any cases in which ... share any part". 1985 refuses programs whose identifier-1 is the record area. 2023 has no such syntax rule; shared storage is allowed and handled by the overlapping-operand/MOVE rules, possibly undefined.
